workflow: AutoCAD 24.3 desktop COM creates twelve native standard entity families in a scratch document, drives repeated COPY from base 100,200 to +500,+750 and -300,+100, performs one U, then repeats COPY with an editable and locked-layer line
result: Each native family retained its original and produced two new uniquely handled copies at the exact original-relative vectors with layer/color/linetype/lineweight preserved; one U removed both placements, while the locked-layer line was not copied.
